title: Mod SDK 与行业模块：真实签名包打包 → 安装 → 路由 → 重启 → 篡改拒绝 → 卸载
reference_versions_editions_regions: commercial/open-source anchors NOT benchmarked in this run

task_protocol.task: build_mod.py --sign 打包 → /api/mod-store/upload 安装 → 调用 Mod 路由 → SIGKILL 重启 → 篡改包负向 → 卸载
task_protocol.negative: 字节篡改的签名包必须拒绝
task_protocol.signing: 临时 Ed25519 密钥对（仓库外），通过 XCAGI_MOD_PUBLIC_KEY 作为附加信任根

predeclared_metrics_and_tolerances.success_criterion: all task steps return expected business outcome
predeclared_metrics_and_tolerances.fault_criterion: injected fault is rejected AND state remains recoverable
predeclared_metrics_and_tolerances.tolerances: no silent partial state; exact-value checks on money/quantity

model_and_budget: no LLM calls required for this domain; deterministic routes
